fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Optional - leave blank to match every item group.

fields.label: Stock Type
fields.description: Optional - leave blank to match every stock type.

fields.label: Maximum Tasks per Warehouse Order
fields.description: Once an open Warehouse Order matching this rule reaches this many tasks, further tasks spill into a new Warehouse Order instead of joining it. Leave blank for no limit.

fields.label: Maximum Weight per Warehouse Order
fields.description: Optional - leave blank for no weight limit. Uses whatever unit WMS Product's Gross Weight per Unit is recorded in; once an open Warehouse Order's accumulated task weight would exceed this, further tasks spill into a new Warehouse Order.

fields.label: Maximum Volume per Warehouse Order
fields.description: Optional - leave blank for no volume limit. Uses whatever unit WMS Product's Volume per Unit is recorded in.

fields.label: Standard Minutes per Task
fields.description: A rough per-task time estimate used only to cap a Warehouse Order against Maximum Minutes below - not a real time-and-motion measurement.

fields.label: Maximum Estimated Minutes per Warehouse Order
fields.description: Optional - leave blank for no time limit. Only takes effect when Standard Minutes per Task is also set.

fields.label: Pick HU Type
fields.description: Pick activity rules only: every task bundled into one Warehouse Order under this rule shares one auto-created Handling Unit of this type as its destination (mirrors SAP EWM's packing profile). Leave blank to keep today's behavior, where the picker's own scan decides the destination HU.
